text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the spring Tenno Sho has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfazed by the grand arena before her, Mayano Top Gun heads off to have a fun race—as she always does.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While she's making her way to the paddock…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I learn that, after this race, Narita Brian is planning to enter a lengthy training period before the Arima Kinen.
